column1: BES CRM Full Infrastructure Build Tracker

This tracker is built for full GHL business infrastructure projects, not snapshot installs. Use it to manage 30-45 day builds for credit repair, business funding, commercial funding, business acquisition, business setup assistance, real estate/broker, tax preparer, coaching, education, and related regulated or compliance-sensitive business niches. Phase 5 is QA/delivery, and the 3-month support period should begin after final delivery/sign-off.
